scripts.dev: npm run build -w @documind/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @documind/shared" "npm run dev -w @documind/api" "npm run dev -w @documind/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @documind/shared && npm run build -w @documind/api && npm run build -w @documind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @documind/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @documind/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
